purpose: Freeze the first seven retrospective observational pattern candidates so later canonical Change History events can support or contradict them without rewriting the baseline after the fact.

semantics.baselineMeaning: These are retrospective candidate associations discovered from event-triggered Change History before frozenAt. Their existence does not prove learning, prediction, persistence, market frequency or causation.
semantics.prospectiveRule: Only eligible signal events strictly after frozenAt may count as prospective support or counterevidence for these frozen candidates.
semantics.supportRule: A post-freeze scored signal matching the frozen dominant signal is prospective support.
semantics.counterevidenceRule: A post-freeze scored signal opposing the frozen dominant signal is prospective counterevidence.
semantics.noSignalRule: Null, reset/correction, or unchanged signals are not silently converted into support or contradiction.
semantics.eventSamplingBoundary: Change History is event-triggered, not uniform time sampling. Prospective support counts describe recorded eligible change-events only and may not be interpreted as market probability or trend strength.
semantics.promotionBoundary: Prospective support does not automatically create a lesson, prediction, causal claim, policy, methodology change, recommendation authority or execution authority.
